formattedAddress: Ground Floor, Mary Lodge, 21A, Chapel Rd, Ranwar, Bandra West, Mumbai, Maharashtra 400050, India

displayName.text: Subko Specialty Coffee Roasters and Bakehouse

shortFormattedAddress: Ground Floor, Mary Lodge, 21A, Chapel Rd, Ranwar, Bandra West, Mumbai

text.text:
The spot is almost out of reach, on a small street in Bandra, built in a restored two storied Bandra village house, surrounded by similar structures. Very quaint and very charming.
As for food and beverages menu, there is plenty to choose from, and most of the dishes on the menu are on display, which is great.
I loved the rustic bread options used for their toasts and sandwiches, spot on.
During my maiden visit, I ditched usual coffees for a coffee kombucha, and I must say I did the right thing.
About service, our server had some delay with our Beverage order, but they apologized and the quality of the drinks made up for it.
As for the ambiance, great vibe, colourful but not overtoned, and charming architecture of the beautiful house shows  throughout. I could spend hours here.

If all day breakfast/brunch is your goal, then this spot should be on your RADAR.

text.text: This place is like a foodie paradise because all of their food is beautiful and it's on the display at the main counter. After reading reviews I knew I had to try the espresso filled croissant. Normally I don't order coffee desserts but man this one was absolutely delicious. I definitely recommend it! In addition we had the veggie stack sandwich which we also really enjoyed. The honey cappuccino is fantastic if you like sweet coffee and the black coffee is also great.

text.text:
Went there after the much hype about the coffee here.

Ordered for iced mocha and it was watery and tasteless.
The chocolate croissant was served cold and however the chocolate tasted good
The mushroom sandwich was filling but was priced at 595+ taxes

Wa single slice of bread with peanut butter spread and bananas was priced at ₹400
We ordered two more sandwiches and they were decent

We paid 3300 for 3 sandwiches and 3 coffees.

The service is great. The staff very polite.
Attracts trendy crowd.
However would rate it 3.5/5 for poor quality of food

text.text:
This place is a heaven for coffee lovers. Almost all the coffee on their menu is worth a try. I am not an avid coffee fan myself but have friends who are and they drag me to this place ever so often! Over time, I must agree I have come to appreciate this place quite immensely.
Coffee lover or not, this place is a great eatery also. They have amazing croissants, quiche and other items. Highly recommend trying their food! Also, good place to chill like any other coffee joint!

The entree we ordered had a hair! The coffee literally gave me an upset stomach.
The first time we went here, we had loved the Black Forest French toast. But today’s experience was horrible! Usually I avoid giving bad reviews, wouldn’t have even for the hair! But stale milk in coffee is unacceptable! Never expected food poisoning after paying such a hefty amount. Never returning back to this place 🙈
